# VRRig

Kind: context · Defined in [`src/logic/components/vr.h`](../../../src/logic/components/vr.h) · Scene / prefab name: `null` · Described in `data/core.json`

Where the VR play area (OpenXR stage space) sits in the world

## Fields

| Field | Type | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `position` | `glm::vec3` | world position of the stage origin |
| `yaw` | `float` | radians |
| `stick_locomotion` | `bool` | VRControl moves the rig with the left stick (true); off when a system drives it |

## Notes

Emplaced by VRRender; transform() gives stage to world.

## Systems that touch it

Read only by: ChunkManager, DebugMenu, Lights, ProbeVolume, RayScene, VRRender, animals, vegetation. Written by: PlayerControl, PlayerViewpoint, VRControl, VRRoller. Created by: VRRender. Destroyed by: —.

| System | Kind | Scope | Access | Where | What it does with it |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| [ChunkManager](../systems/ChunkManager.md) | system | Host | **read** | tick (loadCenters) | rig position, the second load centre |
| [DebugMenu](../systems/DebugMenu.md) | system | Host | **read** | tick | play area position shown |
| [PlayerControl](../systems/PlayerControl.md) | system | Host | **write** | tick | on VR_RIG: position under the camera on the ground, yaw = camera yaw |
| [PlayerViewpoint](../systems/PlayerViewpoint.md) | system | Host | **write** | tick | when present: yaw, position (so the head lands on the body), stick_locomotion = false |
| [VRControl](../systems/VRControl.md) | system | Host | **readwrite** | init, tick | init puts the play area on the ground at the origin; tick moves position (stick, onto the ground) and yaw (turn) |
| [VRRoller](../systems/VRRoller.md) | system | Host | **readwrite** | init, tick (vrCommand) | init turns stick_locomotion off (VRControl no longer moves it); tick moves position onto the sphere's floor; transform() turns the command to the world |
| [Lights](../systems/service-Lights.md) | service | Host | **read** | update | Rig transform. |
| [ProbeVolume](../systems/service-ProbeVolume.md) | service | Host | **read** | update | Rig transform. |
| [RayScene](../systems/service-RayScene.md) | service | Host | **read** | gatherInstances | Rig transform. |
| [VRRender](../systems/service-VRRender.md) | service | Host | **read+create** | constructor (emplace), updateView | The stage's position and yaw in the world: world pose of each eye. |
| [animals](../systems/pass-animals.md) | pass | Host | **read** | update | Rig transform. |
| [vegetation](../systems/pass-vegetation.md) | pass | Host | **read** | update | Rig transform of the headset eye. |

## Side effects of those systems

- **[ChunkManager](../systems/ChunkManager.md)**
  - Creates one entity per chunk coming into range; never destroys (TerrainSys destroys ChunkDestroying chunks).
- **[DebugMenu](../systems/DebugMenu.md)**
  - One ImGui window "Dynamical" (needs UI before it).
  - Changing the soil or grass height-map parameters makes SoilMaps / GrassPass bake their per-chunk maps again (they watch RenderSettings).
  - Creates torch entities and dynamic boxes (Jolt bodies through RigidBodySys) on button presses; destroys every PointLight entity on "No torches".
- **[Lights](../systems/service-Lights.md)**
  - Writes the mapped lights uniform buffer of the frame and sets Context::lights_buffers.
- **[PlayerControl](../systems/PlayerControl.md)**
  - SDL_SetRelativeMouseMode on while the right mouse button is held, off otherwise (not touched while a DesktopView player exists).
  - The fly speed (30 m/s, x1.25 / x0.8 a wheel notch, 1 to 2000) is a function-static shared by every instance.
- **[PlayerViewpoint](../systems/PlayerViewpoint.md)**
  - None beyond the context variables.
- **[ProbeVolume](../systems/service-ProbeVolume.md)**
  - Allocates pages of 3D probe textures (61 MB each, logged), uploads the brick table and the probe classes.
  - Records the probe dispatches into the frame's compute command buffer.
  - Writes the Context probe pointers read by every view set; waits for the device when its buffer grows.
- **[RayScene](../systems/service-RayScene.md)**
  - Builds and refits acceleration structures in the frame's compute command buffer; allocates their buffers, scratch, geometry table and instance buffers.
  - Writes Context::tlas, ray_geometries and ray_textures, which every view set gets.
  - Connects onChunkGone to on_destroy<ChunkTriangles>; the destructor disconnects it and waits for the device.
- **[VRControl](../systems/VRControl.md)**
  - Hands are only made when VRInput is enabled and box.gltf loads; the RigidBody system gives them kinematic Jolt bodies that push dynamic bodies around.
  - Each press of the right trigger spawns a box 20 cm ahead of the controller with 1.5x the hand's velocity (a new entity and Jolt body per press, never destroyed).
- **[VRRender](../systems/service-VRRender.md)**
  - Makes VRActions (which emplaces VRInput) even without a headset.
  - OpenXR: session begin / end / exit, xrWaitFrame (blocks), xrBeginFrame, xrEndFrame, eye swapchain images, view location.
  - GPU: per-frame and per-eye uniform buffers and descriptor sets, the headset command buffer.
  - Log: VR session started / stopped / lost, runtime shutting down.
  - Profiler: DY_FRAME_NAMED("Headset"), zones per pass and eye.
- **[VRRoller](../systems/VRRoller.md)**: none beyond its components.
- **[animals](../systems/pass-animals.md)**
  - Loads species geometry and textures on taskflow workers; uploads buffers and textures.
  - Writes the skinning matrices of the frame into a mapped storage buffer per frame in flight.
  - With ray tracing records animal_skin.rt.comp.glsl dispatches into the frame's compute command buffer.
  - Logs species loaded and failures, and a warning past 65536 joints in view.
- **[vegetation](../systems/pass-vegetation.md)**
  - Loads species geometry and textures on taskflow workers (silent_async, 6 at a time); uploads buffers and textures, allocates descriptor sets.
  - Logs each species loaded, errors for species and textures that fail.
  - With ray tracing gives meshes and textures to the rays (RayMeshes).
  - Records the plant draws and the far volume boxes of both targets; the destructor waits for running jobs.
